subject.title: [Performance] Duplicate parsing of CA certificates in node-extra-ca-certs.ts on every connection

question: Should the project spend a bounded profiling pass on the reporter's parallel HTTPS workload before closing this source-contradicted performance report?
rationale: Source and Node's contract refute the proposed mechanism, but only a runtime profile can exclude a different repeated synchronous TLS path under the claimed workload.

options.title: Request bounded profile
options.body: Ask for or run a minimal current-main CPU/filesystem profile that attributes repeated synchronous work during parallel HTTPS connections.

options.title: Close as unsupported
options.body: Close because the named OpenClaw path performs only startup discovery and the report provides no measured stack or reproduction.

recommendation.title: Request bounded profile
recommendation.body: Ask for or run a minimal current-main CPU/filesystem profile that attributes repeated synchronous work during parallel HTTPS connections.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent merged CA bootstrap history identifies steipete as the strongest available owner for deciding whether additional profiling is worth the maintenance cost.
